response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT constructorId, COUNT(*) AS standings_records FROM constructorStandings GROUP BY constructorId), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(standings_records) AS avg_records FROM counts) SELECT c.constructorId, c.nationality, counts.standings_records, counts.standings_records - average_count.avg_records AS difference_from_average FROM counts JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructorId = counts.constructorId CROSS JOIN average_count WHERE counts.standings_records > average_count.avg_records ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC, c.constructorId LIMIT 10;
